names_authority: User confirmation on 2026-10-10: organizer confirmed the 27 category names
definitions_authority: User approval on 2026-10-10: Approve for development; unresolved overlaps go to review

entries.name: Purchase
entries.definition: Supplier goods/services purchase invoice recorded
entries.boundary: Invoice recognition is different from placing order or physical receipt; import may use purchase as base voucher
entries.provenance: Official documentation interpreted; not verbatim text or confirmed organizer label policy

entries.name: Sales
entries.definition: Customer sale invoice issued/recognized
entries.boundary: Invoice recognized, not just an accepted order or dispatch
entries.provenance: Official documentation interpreted; not verbatim text or confirmed organizer label policy

entries.name: Purchase Return / Debit Note
entries.definition: Return of purchased goods or downward purchase-value adjustment with accounting impact
entries.boundary: Debit note adjusts purchase/party accounting; rejection out before purchase may be inventory-only
entries.provenance: Official documentation interpreted; not verbatim text or confirmed organizer label policy

entries.name: Sales Return / Credit Note
entries.definition: Customer returns invoiced sale or recorded sales value is reduced
entries.boundary: Credit note changes accounting for billed sale; rejection in before sales invoice is operational
entries.provenance: Official documentation interpreted; not verbatim text or confirmed organizer label policy

entries.name: Payment
entries.definition: Disbursement of money to an external party or for an obligation
entries.boundary: External settlement; payment purpose may overlap custom Expense or Advance labels
entries.provenance: Official documentation interpreted; not verbatim text or confirmed organizer label policy

entries.name: Receipt
entries.definition: Money received into company cash/bank from external party
entries.boundary: Receipt of cash is distinct from posting a sales invoice
entries.provenance: Official documentation interpreted; not verbatim text or confirmed organizer label policy

entries.name: Contra
entries.definition: Transfer within business-owned cash and bank accounts
entries.boundary: Internal ownership distinguishes it from payment to an external counterparty
entries.provenance: Official documentation interpreted; not verbatim text or confirmed organizer label policy

entries.name: Journal
entries.definition: Debit/credit accounting adjustment without a more specific primary voucher event
entries.boundary: Accounting adjustment vs specific inventory transfer or cash payment
entries.provenance: Official documentation interpreted; not verbatim text or confirmed organizer label policy

entries.name: Salary / Payroll
entries.definition: Employee wage/salary accrual or payroll settlement
entries.boundary: Payroll calculation/accrual distinct from attendance recording or generic payment
entries.provenance: Official documentation interpreted; not verbatim text or confirmed organizer label policy

entries.name: Attendance
entries.definition: Employee attendance/leave/overtime/production units recorded
entries.boundary: Records units and attendance, not salary payment
entries.provenance: Official documentation interpreted; not verbatim text or confirmed organizer label policy

entries.name: Purchase Order
entries.definition: Buyer commits/requests goods or services from supplier
entries.boundary: Order precedes goods receipt/invoice and does not prove either occurred
entries.provenance: Official documentation interpreted; not verbatim text or confirmed organizer label policy

entries.name: Sales Order
entries.definition: Customer order accepted prior to delivery/invoicing
entries.boundary: Order acknowledgement, not delivery or sales invoice
entries.provenance: Official documentation interpreted; not verbatim text or confirmed organizer label policy

entries.name: Receipt Note
entries.definition: Incoming goods physically received from supplier before/alongside purchase processing
entries.boundary: Goods receipt event, not necessarily a supplier invoice; Material In often job-work context
entries.provenance: Official documentation interpreted; not verbatim text or confirmed organizer label policy

entries.name: Delivery Note
entries.definition: Goods dispatched/delivered to customer independent of sale invoice stage
entries.boundary: Physical delivery stage, not necessarily revenue recognition
entries.provenance: Official documentation interpreted; not verbatim text or confirmed organizer label policy

entries.name: Rejection In
entries.definition: Goods rejected/returned by customer at delivery-note stage before sales invoicing
entries.boundary: Pre-invoice rejection is distinct from credited return of already invoiced sale
entries.provenance: Official documentation interpreted; not verbatim text or confirmed organizer label policy

entries.name: Rejection Out
entries.definition: Goods rejected/returned to supplier at receipt-note stage before purchase invoicing
entries.boundary: Pre-invoice inventory rejection vs debit note on accounted purchase
entries.provenance: Official documentation interpreted; not verbatim text or confirmed organizer label policy

entries.name: Stock Journal
entries.definition: Internal stock transfer or raw material consumption / production movement
entries.boundary: Moves or transforms stock; does not merely correct counted quantity
entries.provenance: Official documentation interpreted; not verbatim text or confirmed organizer label policy

entries.name: Physical Stock
entries.definition: Physical inventory count reconciled with recorded book quantity
entries.boundary: Corrects stock to counted quantity, not a shipment or stock transfer
entries.provenance: Official documentation interpreted; not verbatim text or confirmed organizer label policy

entries.name: Material In
entries.definition: Job-work related material physically received by reporting company
entries.boundary: Could be raw materials received by job worker OR finished goods received by principal
entries.provenance: Official documentation interpreted; not verbatim text or confirmed organizer label policy

entries.name: Material Out
entries.definition: Job-work related material physically sent out from reporting company
entries.boundary: Could be raw materials sent by principal OR finished goods dispatched by job worker
entries.provenance: Official documentation interpreted; not verbatim text or confirmed organizer label policy

entries.name: Job Work In Order
entries.definition: Job worker receives order to process or manufacture for a principal
entries.boundary: Perspective is job worker accepting work; material receipt is a separate voucher
entries.provenance: Official documentation interpreted; not verbatim text or confirmed organizer label policy

entries.name: Job Work Out Order
entries.definition: Principal manufacturer assigns processing/manufacturing job to an external worker
entries.boundary: Perspective is principal sending work out; raw material dispatch is separate event
entries.provenance: Official documentation interpreted; not verbatim text or confirmed organizer label policy

entries.name: Import
entries.definition: Purchase of goods/services from foreign supplier; import transaction context
entries.boundary: Tally commonly books imports in Purchase voucher; organizer must define if Import overrides Purchase
entries.provenance: Official documentation interpreted; not verbatim text or confirmed organizer label policy

entries.name: Export
entries.definition: Sale of goods/services to foreign customer; export transaction context
entries.boundary: Tally often books exports in Sales voucher; organizer must define if Export overrides Sales
entries.provenance: Official documentation interpreted; not verbatim text or confirmed organizer label policy

entries.name: Expense
entries.definition: Business expense incurred or recognized such as rent/utilities/travel
entries.boundary: Expense is economic nature; vendor cash payment may separately be Payment voucher
entries.provenance: Official documentation interpreted; not verbatim text or confirmed organizer label policy

entries.name: Advance / Prepayment
entries.definition: Money paid or received before final invoice, or an expense prepaid for future periods
entries.boundary: Advance is a purpose/timing overlay on Payment or Receipt; distinguish prepaid expense recognition
entries.provenance: Official documentation interpreted; not verbatim text or confirmed organizer label policy

entries.name: Other / Miscellaneous
entries.definition: Transaction not safely covered by allowed categories once sufficient data and organizer rules are considered
entries.boundary: Do NOT use as default merely because data is missing: prefer review_required/null when permitted
entries.provenance: Official documentation interpreted; not verbatim text or confirmed organizer label policy

confusion_boundaries.evidence_for_b: Order is only a purchasing commitment

confusion_boundaries.evidence_for_a: Against recorded purchase; accounting value affected
confusion_boundaries.evidence_for_b: Supplier return at receipt stage before purchase invoice

confusion_boundaries.evidence_for_a: Against recorded sales invoice; customer credit
Company is job worker receiving assignment
confusion_boundaries.evidence_for_b: Company is principal commissioning external worker

confusion_boundaries.evidence_for_a: Cross-border purchase when custom Import label takes precedence
confusion_boundaries.evidence_for_b: Underlying purchase voucher; collision requires organizer policy

confusion_boundaries.evidence_for_a: Cross-border sale when custom Export label takes precedence
confusion_boundaries.evidence_for_b: Underlying sales voucher; collision requires organizer policy
Cash or bank settlement (can be same real event)

confusion_boundaries.evidence_for_a: Money paid/received before invoice; advance reference
confusion_boundaries.evidence_for_b: Ordinary settlement of an already billed obligation

confusion_boundaries.evidence_for_a: Use only with explicit organizer definition
confusion_boundaries.evidence_for_b: Insufficient evidence must not automatically become Other

confusion_boundaries.evidence_for_a: Employee payroll period and pay heads/deductions
confusion_boundaries.evidence_for_b: Generic external payment independent of payroll processing
Customer funds received before final invoice
